data.action: 咖啡馆开店前把咖啡豆与小白花放入捧花，闻到点心香后放松微笑
data.description: 【星光咖啡馆露台·清晨】栞那穿着带围裙式腰饰的白色婚纱，站在刚开店的露台旁，把咖啡豆与小白花一起放进捧花；她闻到第一炉点心的香气便弯起眼睛，像把日常工作变成了婚礼。
data.lighting: soft morning light over the pastry window
data.mood: 把长年手艺写进花嫁日常
data.promptProse: Kanna stands beside the newly opened cafe terrace in her white bridal dress with apron-style waist detail and rose-gold buttons, adding coffee beans and small white flowers to her bouquet. She smiles at the first pastry batch's aroma. The vertical medium-full view includes the dress hem and pastry window behind. Soft morning light shines on the bouquet petals and buttons, with warm window reflections across the shaded waist folds.
data.title: 明月栞那 · 星光咖啡馆的白色花嫁
